sloka: विषण्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसं हरियूथपाः।ततः परमसंहृष्टा लक्ष्मणं चाभ्यपूजयन् ।। ६.९०.४८ ।।
transliteration: viṣaṇṇavadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaṁ hariyūthapāḥ।tataḥ paramasaṁhṛṣṭā lakṣmaṇaṁ cābhyapūjayan ।। 6.90.48 ।।

translations.english: Then the four monkey leaders, Pramati, Rabahasa, Sarabha, and Gandamadhana exhibited their intolerance and went quickly.
